title: Where the charts find the engine and Graphviz
summary: The charts find dot.exe by DRAGLINT_DOT, settings.json, the installed layout, then the shared default
intro: Point the charts at a different Graphviz without editing anything: set DRAGLINT_DOT, or put a dot key in %APPDATA%\drag-lint\settings.json. A path you set that does not exist is an error naming where it was set; nothing set means the installed layout, then the shared default.
